scoring_justification: The agent only submits a single scalar band gap; there is no raw DOS or band structure artifact from which to recompute the gap. Therefore we compare the reported value to the paper's computed band gap (3.1 eV) with a tolerance.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing the band gap in eV.

outputs.description: The computed electronic band gap of H2Ti6O13 from the DFT calculation.

output_contract.notes: The DFT calculation uses the published crystal structure; no wet-lab or diffraction data are required. The result is a single number representing the computed band gap.
